headword: {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}
gloss: official name; formal name; full official designation

definitions.gloss: official name; formal name; full official designation
definitions.explanation: The full, official name of an organization, law, product, or other entity, as opposed to a common abbreviation or nickname. Often used when introducing a new item or when clarifying what a commonly used short name actually stands for.

examples.japanese: {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}は{何|なん}ですか。
「コンビニ」の{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}は「コンビニエンスストア」だ。
examples.english: The official name of "konbini" is "convenience store."

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}には{必|かなら}ず{会社|かいしゃ}の{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please be sure to enter the official name of the company on the documents.

notes:
Composed of {正式|せいしき} (formal, official) and {名称|めいしょう} (name, designation). Used especially when contrasting a formal name with a nickname, abbreviation, or everyday term — a very common rhetorical move in Japanese quiz shows, trivia, and news explanations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}は〜: the official name is...
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}で{呼|よ}ぶ: to call (something) by its official name
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}を{記入|きにゅう}する: to write in the official name
- {会社|かいしゃ}の{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}: the official name of the company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {略称|りゃくしょう}: abbreviated name, short name — the opposite of {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}
- {通称|つうしょう}: common name, popular name — what something is usually called in practice
- {名称|めいしょう}: name, designation (the general word, without the "official" nuance)
- {本名|ほんみょう}: real name — used for people, not organizations
